label: Interface factor
title: The frozen six-bit touching-strip interface does not close within longitudinal radius two
summary: On the exhaustive declared n=6,7 adjacent-strip reachable family, none of the 16 frozen interface-state masks admits an autonomous local factor at longitudinal radius 0, 1, or 2. Full-state radius-1 and radius-2 conflicts replay to causally relevant physical differences outside the retained four-row band.
takeaway: The natural six-bit symbolic interface is still too small to make touching-strip dynamics locally autonomous within the tested budget. This closes one finite-interface attempt negatively without ruling out larger, history-bearing, moving, or nonlocal descriptions.
